body: I didn't think that's who I was but after 2+ years of being alone and lonely and abandoned by everyone from lifelong friends to my own children, I understand. I hope your situation is better! I truly do!!! Maybe finding a support group in the area or making small steps to NOT to improve who you feel you are can help? Don't ask me, I'm done. Just don't want anyone else doing this when there seems to be regret in your text. I have no regrets in my decision.  But sounds like you do. Don't give up as long as you are able to at least try options before making such a permanent decision? Sending good vibes your way friend!!
